direct_rejection_chain.fact: TilingFusedInferAttentionScoreV2Sink calls RouteToFia; false returns GRAPH_FAILED at line35 without a descriptive route-rejection error.
BF16 matching Q/K and no split RoPE enter GQA branch and return CheckGqaConstrain at line420.
CheckGqaConstrain requires layout support, CheckGqaDSupport and feature support; failing D check short-circuits.
CheckGqaDSupport accepts only (Q_D,Q_rope_D,V_D) = (128,0,128),(64,0,64),(128,64,128),(192,0,128),(192,0,192) at lines190-194. (256,0,256) returns false at line198.

why_general_route_inference_was_wrong: GENERAL_GQA selection in fia_tiling_nonquant_sink.cpp:215 is reached only after the top-level whitelist route succeeds; template eligibility checks do not override that earlier guard.
A compiled GENERAL_GQA key exists (104000000030522223 at kernel.cpp:3430), but existence of a key is not an assertion that its storage dimensions support arbitrary D.

The generic FiaKernelNonQuant class still instantiates FiaBlockCubeNonQuantGqa<FIAT> as matmulService at fia_kernel_nonquant_sink.h:115. It does not switch to the separate FiaBlockCubeNonQuant class for D256.

kernel_storage_hazard.fact: For the 516-token target context, MM1 has full128-token N tiles. CopyKToL1 uses aligned subN128 and dDealSize256, requiring32768 BF16 elements in a24576-element KP slot. This overlaps the next slot (or another TPipe region at the last slot). This is a concrete source-level capacity violation if the route guard alone is bypassed.
kernel_storage_hazard.conclusion: Do not treat adding (256,0,256) to CheckGqaDSupport or host-only instrumentation as a safe execution fix. Kernel tile or buffer adaptation is required.

q_l1.target_status: Q4/GQA6 fits the current Q slot; broader q widths do not necessarily fit.

v_l1_l0b.target_status: The existing capacity-driven MM2 K split yields64, so V_L1 and L0B are exact-fit at16384 BF16 elements for D256. No unconditional V-buffer enlargement is established for this narrow shape.

mm2_l0c.target_status: Narrow Q4/GQA6 M=24 (aligned32) fits8192 FP32 elements. A general M128×D256 tile needs32768 elements, twice the slot. Broad D256 enablement needs M/N retile or larger/restructured buffers.

vector_ub.target_status: Vec2 derives row splitting from32KiB / FP32 / D, giving32 rows for D256. No D256-only UB overflow was found in the inspected narrow path; this is not complete runtime/FD/causal qualification.

other_buffers.adaptation_boundary: A narrow no-RoPE Q4/GQA6 port could retile MM1 N to at most96 aligned16 tokens per K slot (64 is conservative), then verify all copy/load/fixpipe paths. It still changes a kernel and requires rebuilt device binaries, bounded canaries and independent numeric tests. General D256 support requires further Q_L1 and MM2_L0C analysis. No adaptation was executed.
